```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css"/>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .sc-wrap { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem; }

  .sc-explain{
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-left:3px solid var(--map-red,#0d9488);
    padding:1rem 1.25rem;
    margin-bottom:1.25rem;
    font-size:.9rem;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
    line-height:1.6;
  }
  .sc-explain strong{color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);}

  .sc-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr;
    gap:1.25rem;
    align-items:stretch;
  }
  @media (max-width: 960px){ .sc-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

  .sc-panel{
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:1.25rem;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:1rem;
    min-height:600px;
  }
  .sc-field{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.35rem; }
  .sc-field label{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:.7rem;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.06em;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
  }
  .sc-field input[type=text],
  .sc-field input[type=search]{
    padding:.55rem .7rem;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    font-size:.9rem;
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;
    background:#fff;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
  }
  .sc-field input:focus{ outline:none; border-color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(13,148,136,.1); }

  .sc-row{ display:flex; gap:.5rem; align-items:center; }
  .sc-row button{
    padding:.55rem 1rem;
    background:var(--map-navy,#0f172a);
    color:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--map-navy,#0f172a);
    border-radius:4px;
    font-size:.85rem;
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;
    font-weight:500;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background .15s;
  }
  .sc-row button:hover{ background:#1e293b; }
  .sc-row button.primary{ background:var(--map-red,#0d9488); border-color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); }
  .sc-row button.primary:hover{ background:#0f766e; }
  .sc-row button:disabled{ opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

  .sc-radius{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.4rem; }
  .sc-radius input[type=range]{ width:100%; accent-color:var(--map-red,#0d9488); }
  .sc-radius .val{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:1.15rem;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
  }

  .sc-verdict{
    padding:1.1rem 1.1rem;
    border-radius:4px;
    background:#f8fafc;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:.5rem;
  }
  .sc-verdict.saturated  { background:#fef2f2; border-left:3px solid #dc2626; }
  .sc-verdict.well-served{ background:#fffbeb; border-left:3px solid #d97706; }
  .sc-verdict.adequate   { background:#f0fdfa; border-left:3px solid #14b8a6; }
  .sc-verdict.underserved{ background:#f0fdf4; border-left:3px solid #16a34a; }
  .sc-verdict.empty      { color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b); font-style:italic; text-align:center; }

  .sc-verdict .badge{
    display:inline-block;
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:.7rem;
    letter-spacing:.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:.2rem .55rem;
    border-radius:2px;
    font-weight:500;
    align-self:flex-start;
  }
  .sc-verdict.saturated  .badge{ background:#dc2626; color:#fff; }
  .sc-verdict.well-served .badge{ background:#d97706; color:#fff; }
  .sc-verdict.adequate    .badge{ background:#14b8a6; color:#fff; }
  .sc-verdict.underserved .badge{ background:#16a34a; color:#fff; }

  .sc-verdict h3{
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;
    font-size:1.25rem;
    font-weight:600;
    margin:0;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
  }
  .sc-verdict p{ margin:0; font-size:.85rem; line-height:1.5; color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b); }

  .sc-metrics{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:.75rem;
    margin-top:.35rem;
  }
  .sc-metric{
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:3px;
    padding:.6rem .7rem;
  }
  .sc-metric .lbl{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:.65rem;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.06em;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
  }
  .sc-metric .val{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:1.25rem;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--map-text,#0f172a);
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  }

  #sc-map{
    height:600px;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    z-index:1;
  }
  @media (max-width: 960px){ #sc-map{ height:400px; } }

  .sc-nearby{
    margin-top:1.25rem;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:4px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .sc-nearby-head{
    padding:.85rem 1rem;
    background:var(--map-navy,#0f172a);
    color:#fff;
    display:flex;
    align-items:baseline;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:1rem;
  }
  .sc-nearby-head h4{
    margin:0;
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:1rem;
  }
  .sc-nearby-head .meta{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:.75rem;
    opacity:.75;
  }
  .sc-nearby table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.85rem; }
  .sc-nearby th{
    background:#f1f5f9;
    padding:.55rem .8rem;
    text-align:left;
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:.72rem;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.05em;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
  }
  .sc-nearby td{ padding:.55rem .8rem; border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9; }
  .sc-nearby td.dist{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    color:var(--map-red,#0d9488);
    font-weight:500;
    text-align:right;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .sc-nearby tbody tr:hover{ background:#f8fafc; }

  .sc-note{
    padding:.6rem .85rem;
    font-size:.78rem;
    color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);
    background:#f8fafc;
    border-left:2px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);
    border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;
  }
</style>

<section class="page-banner">
  <div style="max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;">
    <h1>Site Check</h1>
    <p>Before accrediting a new outlet, check how many existing CPPs already sit within walking distance of the proposed location.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="sc-wrap">

  <div class="sc-explain">
    <strong>How to use it.</strong> Drop a pin on the map at the proposed pharmacy location (or paste GPS coordinates / search an address). PharmaScope returns the number of accredited outlets within your chosen radius, the distance to the nearest one, the density per km<sup>2</sup>, and a suggested verdict &mdash; <em>saturated</em>, <em>well-served</em>, <em>adequate</em>, or <em>under-served</em>. Use it as evidence, not a decision.
  </div>

  <div class="sc-grid">

    <!-- Left panel: inputs + verdict -->
    <div class="sc-panel">

      <div class="sc-field">
        <label for="sc-coords">Coordinates &mdash; lat, lon</label>
        <input type="text" id="sc-coords" placeholder="e.g. -6.798, 39.207" autocomplete="off"/>
      </div>

      <div class="sc-field">
        <label for="sc-addr">Or search an address</label>
        <input type="search" id="sc-addr" placeholder="e.g. Kariakoo, Dar es Salaam" autocomplete="off"/>
      </div>

      <div class="sc-row">
        <button id="sc-locate">Use my location</button>
        <button id="sc-clear">Clear</button>
      </div>

      <div class="sc-radius">
        <label style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);">
          Search radius <span class="val" id="sc-rval">2.0</span> km
        </label>
        <input type="range" id="sc-radius" min="0.5" max="10" step="0.5" value="2"/>
      </div>

      <div class="sc-verdict empty" id="sc-verdict">
        Drop a pin on the map to check this location.
      </div>

      <div class="sc-note">
        Verdict thresholds are density-based (accredited outlets per km<sup>2</sup> inside the search radius). They are guidance only &mdash; the Pharmacy Council retains full discretion on new applications.
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Right: map -->
    <div id="sc-map"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Nearby outlets table -->
  <div class="sc-nearby" id="sc-nearby-block" style="display:none;">
    <div class="sc-nearby-head">
      <h4>Nearby accredited outlets</h4>
      <span class="meta" id="sc-nearby-meta">&mdash;</span>
    </div>
    <div style="max-height:360px;overflow:auto;">
      <table id="sc-nearby-tbl">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Outlet</th>
            <th>Type</th>
            <th>Region / District</th>
            <th style="text-align:right;">Distance</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const CSV_URL = "data/tanzania/addo_standardized.csv";

  // ── Map ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const map = L.map("sc-map", { preferCanvas: true }).setView([-6.4, 35.0], 6);
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png",
    { attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap &copy; CARTO", maxZoom: 19 }).addTo(map);

  const nearbyLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  const backdropLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);   // faint markers outside radius
  let pinMarker = null;
  let radiusCircle = null;

  // ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let all = [];               // CPP rows (geocoded only)
  let currentPin = null;      // { lat, lon }
  let currentRadius = 2.0;    // km

  const els = {
    coords: document.getElementById("sc-coords"),
    addr:   document.getElementById("sc-addr"),
    locate: document.getElementById("sc-locate"),
    clear:  document.getElementById("sc-clear"),
    radius: document.getElementById("sc-radius"),
    rval:   document.getElementById("sc-rval"),
    verdict: document.getElementById("sc-verdict"),
    nearbyBlock: document.getElementById("sc-nearby-block"),
    nearbyMeta:  document.getElementById("sc-nearby-meta"),
    nearbyTbody: document.querySelector("#sc-nearby-tbl tbody"),
  };

  // ── Load CPP data ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  Papa.parse(CSV_URL, {
    download: true, header: true, skipEmptyLines: true, dynamicTyping: false,
    complete: (res) => {
      all = res.data
        .filter(r => r.has_coords === "True" || r.has_coords === "true")
        .map(r => ({
          name: r.addo_name,
          business_type: r.business_type,
          accreditation_source: r.accreditation_source,
          region: r.region,
          district: r.district,
          ward: r.ward,
          lat: parseFloat(r.latitude),
          lon: parseFloat(r.longitude),
        }))
        .filter(r => Number.isFinite(r.lat) && Number.isFinite(r.lon));
      // Faint backdrop so users see the country's outlet distribution
      // before dropping a pin — all 4,370 geocoded outlets as tiny grey dots.
      for (const r of all) {
        L.circleMarker([r.lat, r.lon], {
          radius: 1.5, color: "#94a3b8", weight: 0, fillColor: "#94a3b8", fillOpacity: 0.35,
          interactive: false,
        }).addTo(backdropLayer);
      }
    },
  });

  // ── Map click drops a pin ────────────────────────────────────────
  map.on("click", (e) => setPin(e.latlng.lat, e.latlng.lng));

  els.radius.addEventListener("input", () => {
    currentRadius = parseFloat(els.radius.value);
    els.rval.textContent = currentRadius.toFixed(1);
    if (currentPin) recompute();
  });

  els.coords.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const m = els.coords.value.match(/^\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[, ]\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$/);
    if (!m) return;
    setPin(parseFloat(m[1]), parseFloat(m[2]));
  });

  els.addr.addEventListener("keydown", async (e) => {
    if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
    const q = els.addr.value.trim();
    if (!q) return;
    els.addr.disabled = true;
    try {
      // Nominatim geocoder, biased to Tanzania. OSM rate-limits to 1/sec —
      // single-user interactive use is fine.
      const url = `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&countrycodes=tz&limit=1&q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`;
      const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { "Accept-Language": "en" } });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.length) setPin(parseFloat(data[0].lat), parseFloat(data[0].lon));
      else alert("Address not found in Tanzania. Try a nearby town, or drop the pin on the map.");
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Geocoding failed: " + err.message);
    } finally { els.addr.disabled = false; }
  });

  els.locate.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) { alert("Geolocation is not supported by this browser."); return; }
    els.locate.disabled = true;
    els.locate.textContent = "Locating…";
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        els.locate.disabled = false;
        els.locate.textContent = "Use my location";
        setPin(pos.coords.latitude, pos.coords.longitude);
      },
      (err) => {
        els.locate.disabled = false;
        els.locate.textContent = "Use my location";
        alert("Could not get your location: " + err.message);
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 },
    );
  });

  els.clear.addEventListener("click", () => {
    currentPin = null;
    if (pinMarker) { map.removeLayer(pinMarker); pinMarker = null; }
    if (radiusCircle) { map.removeLayer(radiusCircle); radiusCircle = null; }
    nearbyLayer.clearLayers();
    els.coords.value = "";
    els.addr.value = "";
    els.verdict.className = "sc-verdict empty";
    els.verdict.textContent = "Drop a pin on the map to check this location.";
    els.nearbyBlock.style.display = "none";
    map.setView([-6.4, 35.0], 6);
  });

  // ── Core: drop pin + recompute ───────────────────────────────────
  function setPin(lat, lon) {
    currentPin = { lat, lon };
    els.coords.value = `${lat.toFixed(6)}, ${lon.toFixed(6)}`;

    if (pinMarker) map.removeLayer(pinMarker);
    pinMarker = L.marker([lat, lon], {
      icon: L.divIcon({
        className: "sc-pin",
        html: `<div style="width:22px;height:22px;background:#0f172a;border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3);"></div>`,
        iconSize: [22, 22], iconAnchor: [11, 11],
      }),
    }).addTo(map);

    recompute();
  }

  function recompute() {
    if (!currentPin) return;
    const { lat, lon } = currentPin;
    const R = currentRadius;

    // Update radius circle
    if (radiusCircle) map.removeLayer(radiusCircle);
    radiusCircle = L.circle([lat, lon], {
      radius: R * 1000, color: "#0d9488", weight: 1.5, opacity: 0.6,
      fillColor: "#0d9488", fillOpacity: 0.08,
    }).addTo(map);

    // Fit view so both pin and circle are visible
    map.fitBounds(radiusCircle.getBounds().pad(0.25));

    // Compute distances
    const withDist = all.map(r => ({ ...r, dist_km: haversineKm(lat, lon, r.lat, r.lon) }));
    const inRadius = withDist.filter(r => r.dist_km <= R).sort((a, b) => a.dist_km - b.dist_km);
    const nearest = withDist.reduce((min, r) => r.dist_km < min.dist_km ? r : min, { dist_km: Infinity });

    // Draw nearby markers
    nearbyLayer.clearLayers();
    for (const r of inRadius) {
      L.circleMarker([r.lat, r.lon], {
        radius: 6, color: "#0d9488", fillColor: "#14b8a6", fillOpacity: 0.85, weight: 1.5,
      }).bindPopup(popupHtml(r)).addTo(nearbyLayer);
    }
    // Also highlight the single nearest outlet even if outside radius
    if (nearest.dist_km !== Infinity && nearest.dist_km > R) {
      L.circleMarker([nearest.lat, nearest.lon], {
        radius: 5, color: "#64748b", fillColor: "#94a3b8", fillOpacity: 0.7, weight: 1,
      }).bindPopup(popupHtml(nearest) + `<br/><em>Nearest overall &mdash; ${nearest.dist_km.toFixed(2)} km</em>`).addTo(nearbyLayer);
    }

    // Verdict
    const areaKm2 = Math.PI * R * R;
    const density = inRadius.length / areaKm2;
    const verdict = classify(density, inRadius.length, nearest.dist_km);
    renderVerdict(verdict, inRadius.length, density, nearest.dist_km, R);
    renderNearby(inRadius, R);
  }

  function haversineKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
    const R = 6371;
    const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI / 180;
    const dLon = (lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI / 180;
    const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
              Math.cos(lat1 * Math.PI / 180) * Math.cos(lat2 * Math.PI / 180) *
              Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
    return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  }

  // Verdict thresholds — density (outlets/km²) inside the search radius.
  // Calibration reflects the national gradient: Kariakoo/Dar CBD scores
  // "saturated" (>3/km²); typical urban wards land in "well-served"; most
  // rural wards register as "under-served" or "adequate".
  function classify(density, count, nearestKm) {
    if (count === 0) {
      return {
        key: "underserved",
        label: "Under-served",
        headline: "No accredited outlet in this radius.",
        body: `The nearest existing CPP is ${nearestKm === Infinity ? "not on record" : nearestKm.toFixed(2) + " km"} away. This location is a strong candidate for a new accredited outlet.`,
      };
    }
    if (density < 0.5) {
      return {
        key: "underserved",
        label: "Under-served",
        headline: "Sparse coverage nearby.",
        body: "Density is below 0.5 outlets/km². Approving a new outlet here would improve local access.",
      };
    }
    if (density < 1.5) {
      return {
        key: "adequate",
        label: "Adequate",
        headline: "Coverage is adequate.",
        body: "Density sits in the 0.5&ndash;1.5 outlets/km² band. A new outlet would neither create a gap nor a saturation; assess case-by-case.",
      };
    }
    if (density < 3.0) {
      return {
        key: "well-served",
        label: "Well-served",
        headline: "This area is already well-served.",
        body: "Density is 1.5&ndash;3 outlets/km². Consider whether the applicant can justify additional local demand or should be redirected to an under-served ward.",
      };
    }
    return {
      key: "saturated",
      label: "Saturated",
      headline: "This locality is saturated.",
      body: "Density exceeds 3 outlets/km². Recommend redirecting the applicant to an under-served ward &mdash; use the Regions view on the CPP Registry to identify gaps.",
    };
  }

  function renderVerdict(v, count, density, nearestKm, radius) {
    els.verdict.className = `sc-verdict ${v.key}`;
    els.verdict.innerHTML = `
      <span class="badge">${escapeHtml(v.label)}</span>
      <h3>${escapeHtml(v.headline)}</h3>
      <p>${v.body}</p>
      <div class="sc-metrics">
        <div class="sc-metric"><div class="lbl">Outlets within ${radius.toFixed(1)} km</div><div class="val">${count.toLocaleString()}</div></div>
        <div class="sc-metric"><div class="lbl">Density (per km²)</div><div class="val">${density.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
        <div class="sc-metric"><div class="lbl">Nearest outlet</div><div class="val">${nearestKm === Infinity ? "&mdash;" : nearestKm.toFixed(2) + " km"}</div></div>
        <div class="sc-metric"><div class="lbl">Circle area</div><div class="val">${(Math.PI * radius * radius).toFixed(1)} km²</div></div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function renderNearby(rows, radius) {
    els.nearbyBlock.style.display = "block";
    els.nearbyMeta.textContent = `${rows.length.toLocaleString()} within ${radius.toFixed(1)} km`;
    if (!rows.length) {
      els.nearbyTbody.innerHTML = "";
      els.nearbyMeta.textContent = `0 within ${radius.toFixed(1)} km — nearest overall is highlighted on the map`;
      return;
    }
    const show = rows.slice(0, 50);
    els.nearbyTbody.innerHTML = show.map(r => `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>${escapeHtml(r.name || "—")}</strong></td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(r.business_type || "—")}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml([r.district, r.region].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "—")}</td>
        <td class="dist">${r.dist_km.toFixed(2)} km</td>
      </tr>
    `).join("");
    if (rows.length > 50) {
      els.nearbyTbody.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",
        `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center;font-style:italic;color:#64748b;padding:.75rem;">Showing 50 of ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} — narrow the radius for the full list.</td></tr>`);
    }
  }

  function popupHtml(r) {
    return `<strong>${escapeHtml(r.name || "—")}</strong><br/>` +
           `${escapeHtml(r.business_type || "—")} · ${escapeHtml(r.accreditation_source || "—")}<br/>` +
           `${escapeHtml([r.ward, r.district, r.region].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "—")}<br/>` +
           `<strong style="color:#0d9488;">${r.dist_km.toFixed(2)} km</strong> from the pin`;
  }

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]));
  }
})();
</script>
```
